title: Shunt-capacitor impedance: +3V3
assumptions: Small-signal 1 A AC current at U1 pad 1; voltage magnitude equals impedance in ohms.
Nominal capacitor values; each capacitor has assumed ESR 0.03 ohm and ESL 0.8 nH.
Connection inductance uses a rough 0.7 nH/mm rule of thumb; it is not a field-extracted parasitic model.
Only the listed capacitor branches are modeled; regulator, IC, plane spreading, shared-path coupling and cable impedances are omitted.
Comparison adds 100 nF at the port with an assumed 1 mm connection and the same ESR/ESL.
C1: measured signal route 1.79 mm; return distance estimated at 4.8 mm (plane/current path unresolved).
warnings: Estimated passive-network impedance, not radiated emissions or a compliance result.
DC bias, capacitor tolerances and frequency-dependent losses are not characterized.
Full IC and custom behavioral models are not executed. A completed passive comparison does not validate the whole circuit or any custom IC model.
